description.en:
Around 1691-92: The land is ruled by the Satomi clan. Inue Shimbē Masashi and his twin younger sister, Fuse, had lost their parents, so they become the new clan heads. Inue also becomes leader of the Hakkenshi, 8 elite warriors loyal to the Satomi clan.

Present time, 1991-92.
The Hakkenshi are reincarnated into normal people, each of them connected to a bead containing a kanji character that reflects one of the eight fundamental virtues of Confucianism. Each Hakkenshi is now studying/working at CLAMP Gakuen.

Kazae Tōma, Inue Shimbē Masashi's reincarnation, is a 1st year high school student in CLAMP Gakuen. In his dreams he keeps on seeing glimpses of his past life he can't remember.

biography.en:
CLAMP is a four-woman manga studio formed from the remaining members of the CLAMP doujinshi circle.

- [Ohkawa Ageha](https://mangadex.org/author/937ca459-3e37-450f-9114-ef81a37e335f/ohkawa-ageha) (leader; story & script)
- [Apapa Mokona](https://mangadex.org/author/259db6b3-3c79-4bbc-82f4-b65dde73e904/apapa-mokona) (lead artist; colorist)
- [Nekoi Tsubaki](https://mangadex.org/author/3dffe29e-f96d-446b-a288-84120d4f1297/nekoi-tsubaki) (art assistant; chibi artist)
- [Igarashi Satsuki](https://mangadex.org/author/93512b92-b84c-44df-8cfc-47182f6dcb98/igarashi-satsuki) (design; art assistant)
